description: This file is a CodeMirror addon for linting, providing functions for displaying linting tooltips, markers, and managing linting state within the CodeMirror editor.

classes.name: LintState
classes.description: Manages the linting state, including marked annotations, options, and gutter presence.

methods.name: showTooltip
methods.description: Creates and displays a tooltip element with the provided content at the mouse event position.

methods.name: rm
methods.description: Removes a DOM element from its parent.

methods.name: hideTooltip
methods.description: Hides and removes the tooltip element.

methods.name: showTooltipFor
methods.description: Displays a tooltip for a specific CodeMirror node, with hide logic on mouseout.

methods.name: clearMarks
methods.description: Clears all lint markers and error line highlights from the editor.

methods.name: clearErrorLines
methods.description: Removes error line classes from all lines.

methods.name: makeMarker
methods.description: Creates a gutter marker element for lint annotations.

methods.name: getMaxSeverity
methods.description: Determines the maximum severity between two severity levels.

methods.name: groupByLine
methods.description: Groups annotations by their line number.

methods.name: annotationTooltip
methods.description: Creates a tooltip element for a lint annotation.

methods.name: lintAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous linting with a callback.

methods.name: startLinting
methods.description: Initiates linting process based on current configuration.

methods.name: updateLinting
methods.description: Updates the editor with new lint annotations, markers, and highlights.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles change events to trigger linting after a delay.

methods.name: popupTooltips
methods.description: Displays tooltip popups for multiple annotations.

methods.name: onMouseOver
methods.description: Handles mouseover events on lint markers to show annotations.
